findings.title: Louisiana Medicaid Services Manual, Chapter 5: Professional Services
findings.quote: Coverage of bariatric surgery requires prior authorization (PA).
findings.note: Deepest FFS governing doc: physician/professional-services chapter with per-procedure PA and medical-necessity criteria (e.g., conservative-therapy requirements for select surgeries). No orthopedic/MSK-specific criteria section found; most members are in Healthy Louisiana MCOs applying InterQual/MCG.

findings.title: MaineCare Benefits Manual, Ch.II Sec.90 Physician Services, 90.05-1 Services Covered With Prior Authorization (PA)
findings.quote: Providers are responsible for checking each procedure code on the OMS website to determine whether it is covered and whether it requires prior authorization.
findings.note: Sec.90.05-1 lists PA-required surgeries (orthognathic, gastric bypass, breast reduction/reconstruction, gender-dysphoria surgery, out-of-state services) - routine orthopedic surgery is NOT on the FFS PA list; PA flags are per procedure code on the OMS site. Official rule file (Word) at https://www.maine.gov/sos/sites/maine.gov.sos/files/inline-files/c2s090%2005.14.2022%20%28ACK%29.docx (fetched as binary; text confirmed via this mirror). Primarily FFS; UR by Acentra/Kepro.

findings.title: Maryland Medical Assistance Program - 2026 Professional Services and Podiatry Provider Manual
findings.quote: The fee schedule is subject to change at any time; therefore, providers are responsible for determining if a CPT/HCPCS code requires preauthorization, prior to the service being rendered.
findings.note: Deepest FFS governing doc (linked from the MMCP Professional Services information center; the old health.maryland.gov/mmcp preauthorization page 404s). Preauth flags live in the Professional Services Fee Schedule Note column; no ortho-specific criteria published. HealthChoice MCOs apply InterQual/MCG.

findings.title: MassHealth Guidelines for Medical Necessity Determination for Knee Arthroplasty
findings.quote: Three months or more of non-operative care including at least two or more from the list in Appendix A has failed to improve symptoms
findings.note: Procedure-specific GMND used by MassHealth reviewers for TKA prior authorization. A companion GMND for Knee Arthroscopy also exists (see separate finding). No hip/shoulder/spine GMNDs on the MassHealth GMND list.

findings.title: MassHealth Guidelines for Medical Necessity Determination for Knee Arthroscopy
findings.quote: At least 12 weeks of knee pain with documented loss of function...impacting the ability to accomplish activities of daily living (ADLs)
findings.note: Procedure-specific GMND; includes Section 7 'Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) reconstruction or repair' with dedicated medical-necessity criteria. Landing page: https://www.mass.gov/guides/masshealth-guidelines-for-medical-necessity-determination-for-knee-arthroscopy

findings.title: MDHHS Michigan Medicaid Provider Manual (Practitioner and General Information for Providers chapters)
findings.quote: In order for Medicaid to reimburse the provider in this situation, MDHHS requires that the provider obtain authorization for these services before the service is rendered.
findings.note: Single consolidated manual PDF; PA rules sit in General Information/Practitioner chapters. No orthopedic-specific FFS criteria located in fetched portions; most beneficiaries are in Medicaid Health Plans applying their own UM criteria (InterQual/MCG).

findings.title: MHCP Provider Manual - Physician and Professional Services
findings.quote: Authorization is required for some MHCP-covered services including all investigative procedures and procedures that may be considered cosmetic.
findings.note: Deeper than the generic Authorization section (ID_008925): the Physician and Professional Services chapter governs surgical authorization; PA flags are in the MHCP Fee Schedule PA-indicator column; review agent is Acentra Health. No ortho-specific criteria published; PMAP MCOs use own criteria.

findings.title: DOM MESA Procedure Code Prior Authorization Required list (July 2026)
findings.note: Admin Code Title 23 Part 203 Physician Services (eff. 08/01/26, fetched) contains no ortho surgery PA criteria, so the governing FFS document for our CPTs is this MESA PA-required code list; UM/QIO review by Telligen (msmedicaid.telligen.com). Landing page: https://medicaid.ms.gov/procedure-code-pa-requirement/. MississippiCAN MCOs use InterQual/MCG.

findings.title: MO HealthNet Physicians Provider Manual (Section 13 Benefits and Limitations)
findings.note: Current manual confirmed at this exact URL (landing page https://mydss.mo.gov/media/pdf/physicians-provider-manual); distributed only as a Word .docx that my fetcher returned as unparseable binary, so ortho PA criteria could not be confirmed verbatim. 13 CSR 70-25 (fetched, amended through 6/30/2026) contains no surgical PA criteria; manuals.momed.com is unreachable. Managed-care plans run their own PA.

findings.title: Montana Healthcare Programs - Prior Authorization Information (with Physician-Related Services Manual)
findings.note: PA page (fetched) shows surgical PA reviewed case-by-case by Mountain-Pacific Quality Health; published criteria exist only for non-ortho procedures (breast reconstruction, panniculectomy, orthognathic). Physician-Related Services Manual (medicaidprovider.mt.gov/manuals/physicianrelatedservicesmanual, last update 3/5/2021) has a PA chapter but no orthopedic medical-necessity criteria; fee schedule flags PA code-by-code.

findings.title: 471 NAC Chapter 18 - Physicians' Services (Nebraska Medical Assistance Program)
findings.quote: Physicians must request prior authorization from the Department before providing: (1) Medical transplants; (2) Abortions; (3) Cosmetic and reconstructive surgery; (4) Bariatric surgery for obesity; (5) Out-of-state services, except emergency services provided out-of-state; (6) Established procedures of questionable current usefulness; (7) Procedures which tend to be redundant when performed in combination with other procedures; (8) New procedures of unproven value; (9) Certain drug products; or (10) Ventricular assist device.
findings.note: Regulation (physician chapter) governing FFS PA; routine orthopedic surgery is not on the FFS PA list. Nearly all members are in Heritage Health MCOs, which apply InterQual/MCG; FFS criteria/forms at nebraska.fhsc.com.

findings.title: Nevada Medicaid Services Manual (MSM) - Chapter 600 Physician Services
findings.note: Gainwell provider portal PA reference page (https://www.medicaid.nv.gov/providers/priorauth/referencelists.aspx, fetched) states: 'To verify PA requirements, please refer to the Medicaid Services Manual (MSM) Chapter for your service type.' dhcfp.nv.gov (MSM host) blocks automated fetch via robots.txt for the entire site, so MSM Ch.600 content could not be confirmed; document is public to human users.

findings.title: NH MMIS Health Enterprise Portal - Provider Manuals / Documents and Forms
findings.note: NH billing/provider manuals and PA documents sit behind the NH MMIS Health Enterprise Portal, which states providers 'must be a current provider for Medicaid' to obtain a login. He-W 500 admin rules page (gc.nh.gov/rules/state_agencies/he-w500.html, fetched) contains only a historical conversion index for He-W 531 Physician Services, no current surgical PA criteria. Most members are in Medicaid Care Management MCOs (WellSense, AmeriHealth Caritas NH, NH Healthy Families) applying InterQual/MCG.

findings.title: N.J.A.C. 10:54-3.2 Prior authorization (Physician Services chapter of the NJ Medicaid rules)
findings.quote: Certain services require prior authorization, such as cosmetic surgery, certain psychiatric services and all out-of-State inpatient and outpatient hospital
findings.note: Physician-services rule chapter (N.J.A.C. 10:54) is the FFS governing doc; routine orthopedic surgery is not on the FFS PA list, and the rule itself notes HMO-enrolled beneficiaries need authorization from the HMO - NJ FamilyCare is predominantly MCO-delegated (InterQual/MCG). Official manuals are distributed via njmmis.com (no direct public 10:54 manual link found there).

findings.title: 8.310.2 NMAC - General Benefit Description (Health Care Professional Services)
findings.quote: Services for which prior approval was obtained remain subject to UR at any point in the payment.
findings.note: 8.302.5 NMAC (Prior Authorization and Utilization Review) was repealed 1/1/2014 and replaced by this rule; no ortho-specific FFS criteria - only transplants carry an explicit written-PA mandate. Coverage/PA for our CPTs is delegated to Turquoise Care MCOs (InterQual/MCG) under HCA's managed care program (hca.nm.gov/turquoise-care).

findings.title: NC Medicaid Clinical Coverage Policy No. 1A-30, Spinal Surgeries
findings.quote: Failure of a six (6) consecutive weeks' trial of conservative medical management (unless imaging indicates the need for urgent intervention)
findings.note: Procedure-specific state clinical coverage policy; prior approval required for all non-emergent spinal surgeries; Attachment A lists CPT 22612 among covered fusion codes. PHPs/Tailored Plans must follow state CCPs.

findings.title: NC Medicaid Clinical Coverage Policy No. 1A-30, Spinal Surgeries
findings.quote: Failure of a six (6) consecutive weeks' trial of conservative medical management (unless imaging indicates the need for urgent intervention)
findings.note: Same policy; covers anterior cervical fusion (incl. 22551). Prior approval required except emergent indications in Section 5.1.

findings.title: NC Medicaid Clinical Coverage Policy No. 1A-30, Spinal Surgeries
findings.quote: Failure of a six (6) consecutive weeks' trial of conservative medical management (unless imaging indicates the need for urgent intervention)
findings.note: Same policy; decompression codes incl. 63030 covered. No NC CCP found for joint arthroplasty/arthroscopy CPTs; those fall under general PA and PHP UM.

findings.title: eMedNY Physician Manual - Procedure Codes Section 5: Surgery
findings.quote: Payment for those listed procedures where the MMIS code number is underlined is dependent upon obtaining the approval of the Department of Health prior to performance of the procedure.
findings.note: FFS prior approval is flagged per surgical CPT (underlined codes) in this section; companion Physician Prior Approval Guidelines (Physician_PA_Guidelines.pdf, version 2015-2) contains no procedure criteria. No state ortho medical-necessity criteria published; most members in Medicaid Managed Care plans applying own UM.

findings.title: North Dakota Medicaid Service Authorizations policy (Billing and Policy Manual)
findings.quote: Sufficient medical evidence must be provided to show that a service is medically necessary, and that an error was made.
findings.note: Governing FFS service-authorization policy; does not enumerate surgical CPTs - directs providers to the ND Procedure Code Look-up Tool for SA-required codes. Predominantly FFS; no ortho-specific criteria published.
